meta.name: workflow
meta.description: Use to run a dynamic, goal-driven workflow — orchestrate a multi-step goal by composing skills, tools, and MCPs, with a quality gate and verification at each step. Trigger on "/workflow", "run the <name> workflow", "orchestrate X", or a multi-step recurring goal ("draft the investor update", "give me my morning brief"). Follows references/sops/dynamic-workflows.md and the wf-*.md cards. Respects the autonomy/cadence gate (auto on reversible/internal, draft-then-approve on external/regulated).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 编排多步工作流，自动执行重复任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要把多个步骤组合成自动化工作流
copy.tagline_en: Orchestrate multi-step workflows and automate recurring tasks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to combine multiple steps into an automated workflow

howto.what: Claude 会按照你设定的目标，自动规划步骤，依次调用技能、工具或 MCP 来执行，每一步都检查质量，最后确认结果达标后才报告完成。
howto.when: 当你说“/workflow”、“运行<名称>工作流”、“编排 X”或提出一个多步骤的重复性目标（如“起草投资者更新”）时触发。

say.note: 执行名为 investor-update 的预定义工作流。
Claude 会规划并执行多步任务来生成简报。
触发一个多步骤的起草流程。

howto.what_en: Claude will automatically plan steps, execute skills/tools/MCPs per step, gate each step for quality, verify success criteria, and report completion.
howto.when_en: Triggered by "/workflow", "run the <name> workflow", "orchestrate X", or a multi-step recurring goal like "draft the investor update" or "give me my morning brief".

say_en.note: Claude plans and executes steps to generate the brief.
